column1: # TVI-WO-1202a: each case's and mutant's wall time in seconds, the weight tools/tviburi-route plan packs shards by.
# Re-weighed by TVI-WO-1303a (ruled 2026-11-25T18:49Z Q7: a ninth shard, re-weighed from main's last CI) from main's CI run
# 45620369016 (the push of 3ce7dca, #49's merge: 795 items, eight shard jobs, three CPU models) with 1202a's method: an
# item's time is the gap from the previous item's last line to its own. Each shard's speed is its median item against the
# previous weights, over the run's Intel Xeon 6975P-C shards (four; the EPYC 7763 shards ran at 1.43-1.50, the Platinum
# 8370C at 1.35); an item weighs its time divided by its shard's speed. So every weight is at the 6975P-C's speed (1.00).
# The previous weights (1202a's three runs, then each later WO's own runs) are in this file's git history.
# Never the list of what runs: that is the tree's own (tests/spike.sh, tests/mutants.tsv); an item missing here
# weighs its kind's median and still runs. KIND<tab>ID<tab>SECONDS.
